prerequisites: No prerequisites. Competencies from basic modules (topic-dependent) are recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: Students have advanced basic knowledge and skills in a selected subfield of computer science.
Students know practical concepts and applications in the selected subfield of computer science.
Students are able to apply scientific working methods to independently solve problems and communicate the solution.
Students have acquired competencies, preferably from the field of practical computer science.

assessment_methods.method: Weekly exercise assignments (at least 50% of points)
Oral presentation of solutions for at least two exercise assignments
Written exam or oral examination (individual examination)

assessment_rules: Grading is based on a point scale from 0 to 15 according to the examination regulations for the B.Sc. Computer Science degree program. To acquire credit points, at least 50 percent of the points from the weekly exercise assignments must be achieved, and the solution to at least two exercise assignments must be presented orally. The examination performance is a written exam or an individual oral examination.
